description: Frozen semantic plausibility rules and physical PE invariant bounds for EMBER 2,381 vector validation

rules.name: Byte Histogram Non-negativity
rules.description: Byte frequencies in indices [0, 255] must be non-negative finite values

rules.name: Byte Entropy Histogram Bounds
rules.description: Byte entropy histogram values in indices [256, 511] must be within [0.0, 8.0] Shannon bits

rules.name: General File Size Non-negativity
rules.description: General file size at index 2175 must be non-negative

rules.name: General Virtual Size Non-negativity
rules.description: General virtual size at index 2176 must be non-negative

rules.name: PE Characteristic Boolean Flags
rules.description: Binary indicator flags (has_debug, has_reloc, has_resources, has_sig, has_tls) at indices [2177, 2183] must be binary [0, 1]

rules.name: Import and Export Counts Non-negativity
rules.description: Import and export symbol counts at indices 2178, 2179, 2184 must be non-negative

rules.name: Section Sizes Non-negativity
rules.description: Section sizes in structural view section info must be non-negative

rules.name: Byte Histogram Total Plausibility
rules.description: Sum of byte frequencies in indices [0, 255] should not exceed plausible normalized mass
